name: runbook
description: v0.1.8: cargo fmt --all reformatting only (fixes the 'build & commit plugin binaries' smoke workflow's `cargo fmt --all --check` gate, chronically red on main since 2026-07-21 per scripts/check-ci-red.py); no behavior change. Reusable procedure includes for Claude Code: a UserPromptSubmit hook that expands `!name` macros in your prompt into the matching repo-committed procedure (.runbook/<name>.md), so recurring workflows run the same way every time. Inspired by Devin Playbooks; distinct from knowledge injection. Subscription-native (one hook + bundled Rust binary, no API key).
